summary: Phase 1 of Russell's Studio tested end-to-end. Backend: all 5 pytest cases passed (list, ideas, script, save/list/delete roundtrip, TTS onyx mp3). Frontend: /studio page renders correctly with all required data-testids; espresso martini generated 6 ideas; selecting first idea activates Step 2 with platform tabs; script (TikTok) generated successfully (~3055 chars, includes '## SPOKEN SCRIPT'); save-to-vault created a card; voiceover generated and audio element rendered; delete works (verified via backend roundtrip + cleanup). Note: initial script attempt with platform='both' returned a 502 from the ingress after ~90s — likely proxy/edge timeout on long-form generation, not an app bug; using tiktok platform completed cleanly.

integration_issues.issue: Received HTTP 502 from ingress after ~90s. 'both' asks Claude for BOTH short+long form and can exceed proxy edge timeout. Consider tightening prompt or streaming.

action_items: Optional: consider a shorter/tighter length brief for platform='both' OR add a client-side warning that 'Both' takes longer, to avoid 502 at ingress on long generations.
critical_code_review_comments: Ideas parser is lenient; if Claude ever omits both TITLE+HOOK on a block the block is silently skipped — acceptable.
VoiceoverPlayer uses fetch directly instead of the shared api client — fine since it needs blob, no auth concerns here.
No input length cap on /studio/script text; a huge title/hook could impact latency but negligible risk today.
test_credentials: n/a — Studio has no auth gating
seed_data_creation: Ephemeral TEST_ scripts created during roundtrip test and one via UI; all cleaned up post-run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Studio Phase 1 fully green. When Phase 2 (Sora 2 + Nano Banana + ffmpeg) lands, extend /app/backend/tests/test_studio.py with new endpoint fixtures. Reuse the existing 'espresso martini' topic — it reliably produces 5-6 ideas from Claude.
rca of the issue: The single 502 seen on platform='both' during first UI run is not an app defect. Ingress/edge default timeout is < the time needed for Claude to produce ~1000 words. Mitigation: default to a single-format on the UI or stream the LLM response.
